production_safety.operational_data: No production records or credentials were copied or mutated. A separate empty Postgres QA container received the current schema, 20 synthetic imported service records, three synthetic accounts and a temporary test service that was subsequently deleted.
production_safety.schema_migration: No production schema change. Existing Page and SiteSetting tables store namespaced documents. QA schema was generated only in the separate empty QA container.
external_side_effects: Created bayada-functional-qa-db on existing AWS Docker network without a public port. SSH local forward 55433 connects only that synthetic DB.
Ran local QA apps at ports 3340/3341/3342 and browser flows through Oinzi. Those app processes were stopped after verification; QA DB and tunnel remain for the active task.
No production rollout, external mail or user messages.

verification.evidence: All 10 turbo tasks succeeded after final source edits.

verification.command: Next build --webpack for apps/web and apps/admin with DATABASE_URL empty in child process env
verification.evidence: Both final builds compiled and typechecked. Web generated 229 pages; admin includes /[locale]/web/services.

verification.command: QA importer twice against the synthetic DB
verification.evidence: First run imported 20 documents; second run imported 0.

verification.command: Oinzi QA service CRUD plus direct synthetic DB/read-only HTTP verification
verification.evidence: UI create persisted title/body/FAQ and public detail rendered them. Synthetic concurrent writer caused stale UI save conflict; latest DB title was preserved. UI hide removed home/list/sitemap links and detail returned 404. UI confirmed delete removed row and audit web.service.delete remained. Evidence: output/qa-service-crud-evidence.json, output/qa-service-detail.png.

residual_risks: AWS production rollout and one-time service import have not occurred.
Role-specific unauthorized write runtime verification and full academy/admin cross-testing remain pending in the active goal.
Other hardcoded corporate content (about, policy, audience-specific bodies and homepage sections) still needs editable content integration/review.
Current browser CRUD evidence uses a development runtime; final production deployment verification is still pending.
Source default service images include legacy placeholder paths and need content/image review.
